purpose: Nonblind paired single-case diagnostic: same claim prompt, citations, source snapshot, budget, model and generation parameters as 40-review-budget; only the review system instructions differ. One stochastic call; model version and infrastructure cannot be locked.
pass_rule: Claim indexes 0 and 1 must be supports; index 2 must be does_not_support, contradicts, or uncertain. This expected answer is fixed before the call and is not part of the prompt. Pass only indicates success on this single previously inspected case; it does not establish semantic reliability.
